faq_heading: South Surrey houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a South Surrey house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 65 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,800,000, with the middle half between $1,590,000 and $2,052,380. Every South Surrey detached house had a median of $1,715,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in South Surrey?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 65 South Surrey houses sold with a legal suite and 61 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,596,000.

faq.q: Can a White Rock lot have a suite and a bed and breakfast?
faq.a: Not under the rule as the City writes it. Bylaw 2506 permits no more than one of the listed accessory uses with a one-unit residential use, and both are on the list.

faq.q: Does Surrey’s 40% suite limit apply to South Surrey?
faq.a: Yes, because South Surrey is part of the City of Surrey. It does not apply in White Rock.

faq.q: Which South Surrey neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Grandview had 28 legal-suite sales, Pacific Douglas 12 and King George Corridor 8 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do South Surrey houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 39 days at a median, closing at 96.1% of list, with 8% over the list price.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in South Surrey that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Crescent Beach and Ocean Park (105), Grandview (77), King George Corridor (68), Sunnyside Park (47) and Morgan Creek (43). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 431 detached houses that closed in South Surrey between November 1 and August 31, 126 (29%) had a suite: 65 legal and 61 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,800,000, 5% more than the $1,715,000 median for every South Surrey house.

blocks.text: The typical legal-suite house sits on 4,069 sq ft, against 7,192 sq ft for all South Surrey houses. It has 3,604 square feet of floor area, against 3,140. 98% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 36% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 3,323 square feet and a median $1,596,000.

Alongside suites, 45 South Surrey houses had lane access, at a median of $1,498,500; 10 were marked as a coach or laneway house at $1,640,000; 11 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: South Surrey follows the City of Surrey’s Bylaw No. 12000: one suite for each single-family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling, with its habitable area held to 40% of the principal unit.

White Rock, next door, writes its own rules and is outside these figures. Its Zoning Bylaw 2024, No. 2506 lets a one-unit residential lot have no more than one of several accessory uses, and a registered secondary suite is on that list beside boarding and a bed and breakfast.

Some South Surrey lots are large enough for the multi-unit rules to matter. An eligible lot of 281 square metres or more within 400 metres of a frequent bus stop can hold up to 6 units, which changes how a suite house on one is priced.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in South Surrey & White Rock was $1,612,500 in September 2026, 7.4% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a South Surrey house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the South Surrey permit and final inspection for the suite. 61 of the 126 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Confirm the lot is on the Surrey side of the line. A listing with a White Rock mailing address can still sit in South Surrey, and the reverse is true too.
Measure the suite against the limit of 40% of the principal unit’s habitable area. On the median South Surrey legal-suite house of 3,604 square feet, 40% comes to about 1,440 square feet.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 39 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,596,000 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,800,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
